d:
Revel in the energy of Veera Vinayaka composed and sung by Anirudh Ravichander and also has Vishal Dadlani on the vocals! This track from the Ajith Kumar starrer Vedalam directed by Siva, has lyrics by Viveka. Time to go Ganapthy Bappa Mourya!
Song Name - Veera Vinayaka
Movie - Vedalam
Singer - Anirudh Ravichander & Vishal Dadlani
Music - Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Viveka
Director - Siva
Starring - Ajith Kumar, Shruthi Haasan, Lakshmi Menon, Soori
